# Expected files after /handoff runs
#
# /handoff is a memory-write skill — it produces a compact context packet.
#
# Produces (plan session 7: the /session-save continuity format):
#   .itd-memory/continuity/<topic>.md — the topic document, rewritten whole: frontmatter
#                         (topic, status, updated, branch, unit) + Следующее действие,
#                         Состояние, Решения, Проверки, Блокеры
#   HANDOFF.md          — the same document + `## Передача` in project root
#                         (From → To, reason, inputs [[STATE]]/[[BUILD_PLAN]],
#                         write areas + forbidden changes, verification commands,
#                         [!warning] risks); the next action is one [!todo] line
#   STATE.json (update) — refreshed state slice in the project's memory dir
#                         (schema: docs/templates/itd-memory/STATE.json)
#
# /handoff MUST NOT:
#   - Store secrets / keys / tokens in HANDOFF.md
#   - Modify source code or project artifacts (it transfers context, not work)
#   - Replace /session-save (milestone save) — these are distinct
#
